description: This file defines the FnStream class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace. The class provides a way to create stream implementations based on a hash of functions, enabling easy testing and extension of streams without creating concrete classes. It implements the PSR-7 StreamInterface and allows decorating existing streams with custom behavior via closures.

classes.name: FnStream
classes.description: A class that composes stream implementations based on a hash of functions, allowing dynamic behavior and easy extension of stream objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FnStream with a hash of method names to callables, setting up dynamic methods.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Handles access to unimplemented methods, throwing BadMethodCallException.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Calls the custom close function if provided when the stream object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserializing of the stream object by throwing LogicException.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a decorated stream by intercepting method calls and delegating to either custom handlers or underlying stream methods.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Calls the custom seek handler with offset and whence.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Calls the custom write handler with a string.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Calls the custom read handler with length.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Calls the custom getMetadata handler with an optional key.
